items.title: Stanley Kay interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: when I joined the band we had a bass player that played with Russ Morgan’s band, or Carl Hoff.

ctx.x: I was going to ask, at the time, you guys probably thought, oh come on.

Yeah but you know what? I think George Duvivier, the great George Duvivier was on that. And he was so dedicated that if he played one note, he’d go in to listen to it to see if the note was in tune. He was that kind of guy. That dedicated. And I was in awe of all these guys. Playing with Chris Griffin was the lead player with Benny Goodman, you know. I was in awe. Jack Lesberg was a bass player. I just told — in fact when I joined the band we had a bass player that played with Russ Morgan’s band, or Carl Hoff.…
What was it like traveling on the road at that time?
